scientific_limitations: Applies only to the explicitly specified positive, fixed-thermal-opacity semi-grey irradiated atmosphere model.
One-zero exponential-transform principles and arbitrary visible-band superposition are already known and are not asserted as novel.
The claimed additional physical-parameter threshold, depth asymptotics and weak-transparent-band crossover have not undergone independent historical-priority review.
No conclusion for clouds, variable infrared opacities, scattering, convection, chemical feedback or observable spectra.
title: Spectral saturation and irradiation-strength crossover of semi-grey planetary inversion depths
